::: {.role}
Assistant Professor · Department of Political Science, Aarhus University
:::

I am a computational social scientist working at the intersection of communication
science, political science, and data science. My research asks how digital media
affects contemporary democracy: how political actors — politicians, parties, and
media outlets — communicate strategically on digital platforms, and how citizens
respond to what reaches them, from online misinformation and AI-generated content
to the discussions unfolding in comment sections.

I hold a PhD in Communication Science from the University of Amsterdam, completed in
affiliation with the [Digital Democracy Centre](https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/digital-democracy-centre)
at the University of Southern Denmark.

Methodologically, I collect and analyse large social media datasets through platforms'
research APIs, and combine text-as-data methods with LLM-based content classification,
survey research, and (field) experiments.
